package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"time"
)

// scenario for busy_waiting: select { default: ... } inside loops, which often spins instead of blocking.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: context; severity: contextual.

func waitForReady(done <-chan struct{}) bool {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(3 * time.Second)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		select {
		case <-done:
			return true
		default:
			time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
		}
	}
	return false
}

func pollChannel(ch <-chan int) int {
	for {
		select {
		case v := <-ch:
			return v
		default:
			fmt.Println("still waiting...")
			time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
		}
	}
}
